{"metadata":{"description":"为DeepSeek Harness提供的免费网络搜索服务商——即使没有API密钥也可使用。Free web search provider for DeepSeek Harness - usable even without an API key.","id":"gh:1334384058","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-free-search","slug":"DDDMUC/dsh-free-search","topics":["bing","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","duckduckgo","web-search"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"为DeepSeek Harness提供的免费网络搜索服务商——即使没有API密钥也可使用。Free web search provider for DeepSeek Harness - usable "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"even without an API key."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-free-search"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**DeepSeek Harness 免费搜索插件：无需 API key，零成本，多引擎可切换。** 这是一个给 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 添加多引擎搜索 provider 的插件"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"，注册进 `ctx.web` seam。内置 `web_search` 工具自动选用，支持网页设置页切换引擎、配置 API key、一键测试所有引擎、弹出式命令切换引擎。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文 · English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"▲ 设置页总览"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### 谁需要它"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"如果你："},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- 没有（或不想）配置 DeepSeek 官方 key，用第三方模型供应商发现无法搜索
- 虽然配置了官 key，但用的明明是第三方模型供应商，结果 DeepSeek 账户却依旧扣费"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"这一切都是因为 dsh 默认的搜索 provider 依赖 DeepSeek 官方 API key（`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`）。没有配置官 key，内置搜索就会失败；配置了官 key，即使"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"用第三方模型供应商，搜索时也会使用官方渠道，产生隐形扣费。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"这个插件就是来解决这些问题的：它提供多个免费引擎 + 自动回退，让 DSH 彻底摆脱 DeepSeek 官方 key 的依赖。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 特性"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"#### 引擎与切换"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **零成本** —— 多个免费引擎，无需 key、无需注册
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"#### 回退、冷却与更新"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"#### Multi 与语言池"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"#### 依赖说明"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"插件对 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` 和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 使用 `peerDependencies`，这是刻意的：DSH 运行时必须使用安装"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"树中的唯一实例。请通过 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ...` 安装插件，不要把 DSH 核心包复制进 profile 的本地 `node_modules`；"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"h plugin --profile <profile> add ...` 安装插件，不要把 DSH 核心包复制进 profile 的本地 `node_modules`；重复副本会导致工具调度器失效。"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"#### 安全搜索（safeSearch）"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`safeSearch` 控制内置来源是否额外套一层安全过滤，默认 `off`（不加参数，保持引擎自身默认行为）："},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| 值 | 含义 |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `off`（默认） | 不加过滤参数，保持引擎默认行为 |
| `moderate` | 过滤成人内容 |
| `strict` | 最严格过滤 |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"作用于 **Bing**（`adlt`）、**DuckDuckGo HTML**（`adlt`）、**DuckDuckGo Lite**（`adlt`）；其它引擎没有对应参数，不受影响。设置页有下拉框"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"，也可直接在 config 里写 `safeSearch: moderate`。"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Features"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"#### Why are some engines free?"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The free/paid binary is not what decides **who belongs in a default pool** — the real constraint is "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"the quota model: is there a free allowance, how much, and what happens past it. Five tiers (pick con"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"current pools from these, so a full-pool run does not silently multiply quota):"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Tier | Engines | Past the allowance |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| ① Unlimited, no key | `ddg` / `ddg-lite` / `bing` / `searxng` / `anysearch` | — |
| ② Anonymous qu"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ota (runs without a key) | `exa` / `tavily` / `keenable` / `firecrawl` / `parallel` / `you` (100/day"},{"id":"p30s3","text":") | key raises the quota |
| ③ Free quota (key required) | `zhihu_global` / `zhihu_site` (5,000/day "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"trial), `doubao` (500/month), `baidu` (50/day), `aliyun` (200-call starter pack) | pay-as-you-go |
|"},{"id":"p30s5","text":" ④ Paid upgrade (needs a key to return anything) | `serpbase` (100 free on signup) / `serply` (2,500"},{"id":"p30s6","text":" for 30 days) / `outcrawl` (1,000 credits a month) / `perplexity` / `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"tools` / `kimi` | per call / per query |
| ⑤ Per-call billing (model built-in, explicit-only) | `ope"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"nai` / `gemini` / `claude` | per token + per search |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Rule of thumb for a default pool: **① as the floor + ③ as the workhorse**; ② is allowed but remember"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" it burns anonymous quota; ④ only when you actually want that source; ⑤ never enters a pool. Per-eng"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ine facts and a default-pool proposal live in docs/engine-quota-tiers.md."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"#### Why do some engines not need a key?"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **AnySearch**: its `v1/search` REST endpoint provides anonymous public search quota without regist"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ration or an API key. Quota is rate-limited (fine for daily queries), but as one of the free engines"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" with mutual fallback it stays reliable.
- **Exa**: its public MCP endpoint (`mcp.exa.ai/mcp`) suppo"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"rts anonymous requests, so it works without a key; configuring `EXA_API_KEY` grants a higher usage q"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"uota.
- **Tavily**: offers keyless anonymous quota via the `x-tavily-access-mode: keyless` header — "},{"id":"p33s6","text":"it works without a key; configuring `TAVILY_API_KEY` switches to the account tier for higher quota a"},{"id":"p33s7","text":"nd more stable results.
- **Keenable**: without a key it is called via its public MCP endpoint (`api"},{"id":"p33s8","text":".keenable.ai/mcp`); configuring `KEENABLE_API_KEY` switches to the REST API (`api.keenable.ai/v1/sea"},{"id":"p33s9","text":"rch`) for higher quota and organization-scoped rate limits.
- **Firecrawl**: its `/v2/search` endpoi"},{"id":"p33s10","text":"nt works **without a key** out of the box (the official docs state "No API key needed to get started"},{"id":"p33s11","text":"", with anonymous rate limits); configuring `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` raises the limits. Supports `tbs` ti"},{"id":"p33s12","text":"me filtering (`qdr:h/d/w/m/y` and custom date ranges).
- **You.com**: without a key it calls the off"},{"id":"p33s13","text":"icial keyless tier (`api.you.com/v1/agents/search`), 100 free searches a day with no signup; setting"},{"id":"p33s14","text":" `YDC_API_KEY` (the old `YOUCOM_API_KEY` name still works) switches to the Search API (`ydc-index.io"},{"id":"p33s15","text":"/v1/search`) for higher limits."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"### How It Works"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- `lib/index.js`: Host side. Implements `WebSearchProvider` (`id` / `available()` / `search()`), uni"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"fied engine routing + auto-fallback (paid engines first, free as fallback); parses `timeRange` (fixe"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"d tiers / relative values / absolute dates) and forwards it to each engine; declares its editable co"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"nfig as volatile fields on the `web-search-free` composition entry and ships its own settings page ("},{"id":"p35s5","text":"`plugins.row.config`); provides the `/api/dsh-free-search-settings` read/write bridge + `raw-search`"},{"id":"p35s6","text":" debug endpoint; registers the `free_search_test`, `platform_search`, `video_search`, and `advanced_"},{"id":"p35s7","text":"search` tools; dynamically injects the engine list into system prompts (auto-refreshes on settings c"},{"id":"p35s8","text":"hange).
- `lib/client.js`: Browser side. React configuration card (engine select, key inputs, connec"},{"id":"p35s9","text":"tivity test, and Chinese/English toggle), mounted into the official `plugins.row.config` component-r"},{"id":"p35s10","text":"ow slot on the sidebar Plugins page; registers the `/free-search-engine` popup switch command (`comm"},{"id":"p35s11","text":"andUi` popupSelect, the same mechanism as `/model`).
- `cordis.patch.yml`: Plugin loader configurati"},{"id":"p35s12","text":"Ui` popupSelect, the same mechanism as `/model`).
- `cordis.patch.yml`: Plugin loader configuration."}],"truncated":true}
